question: Coors Field has hosted big-league games since 1995, and only one pitcher has ever thrown a no-hitter there. Who was it?
answer_detail: On a cold, rain-soaked night on Sept. 17, 1996, Nomo no-hit the Rockies for the Dodgers, pitching from the stretch most of the game. Thirty-plus seasons later, it's still the only one. Jiménez's 2010 no-no came in Atlanta.
